summary:
This function is available only when the driver is compiled without NO_WIZARD defined.

   Calling enable_wizard() for an interactive object (player) makes wizardp() return true (1) for that object. It gives the player these three privileges:

   1. Access to the restricted modes of ed when RESTRICTED_ED is defined at driver compile time.
   2. Receipt of detailed runtime error information.
   3. Access to the trace() and traceprefix() efuns.
